mapper.select: SELECT sys10_file_id AS file_id , sys10_parent_id AS parent_id , sys10_file_nm AS file_name , sys10_file_ext AS file_ext , sys10_file_yn AS file_yn , sys10_title_yn AS title_yn , (COALESCE(sys10_print_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS print_yn , (COALESCE(sys10_ext_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS ext_yn , sys10_seq AS seq FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY LPAD(COALESCE(sys10_seq, '99999'), 5, '0'), COALESCE(sys10_title_yn, 'false') DESC, sys10_file_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT sys61_file_del_id AS file_del_id , sys61_file_id AS file_id , sys61_parent_id AS parent_id , sys10_file_nm AS file_name , f_emp_kor_nm(sys61_person_id) AS person_name , sys61_del_date AS del_date , sys61_reason AS reason FROM sys61_file_del INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_file_id = sys61_file_id WHERE sys61_parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sys61_del_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys61_file_del (sys61_file_del_id, sys61_file_id, sys61_parent_id, sys61_del_date, sys61_reason, sys61_note, sys61_person_id) VALUES (#{fileDelId}, #{fileId}, #{parentId}, f_sysdate(), #{reason}, NULL, #{personId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.dcr05_doc_type_id AS doc_type_id , c.sys09_name AS form_class_name , a.dcr05_title AS title , a.dcr05_note AS note , a.dcr05_content AS content FROM dcr05_doc_type a INNER JOIN dcr06_relate_doc_Type b ON a.dcr05_doc_type_id = b.dcr06_doc_type_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT a.* FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'DocFormClassCode' AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code WHERE sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_code = a.sys09_code AND sys09_apply_date <= f_today() ) ) c ON c.sys09_code = a.dcr05_doc_form_class_cd WHERE 1=1 AND dcr06_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND dcr05_company_id = #{companyId} AND dcr05_title LIKE #{titleName} AND dcr05_doc_form_class_cd LIKE #{formClassCode} ORDER BY dcr05_title

SELECT a.dcr05_doc_type_id AS doc_type_id , b.sys09_name AS form_class_name , a.dcr05_title AS title , a.dcr05_note AS note , a.dcr05_content AS content FROM dcr05_doc_type a INNER JOIN ( SELECT a.* FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'DocFormClassCode' AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code WHERE sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_code = a.sys09_code AND sys09_apply_date <= f_today() ) ) b ON b.sys09_code = a.dcr05_doc_form_class_cd WHERE 1=1 AND dcr05_company_id = #{companyId} AND dcr05_doc_form_class_cd LIKE #{formClassCode} AND UPPER(CONCAT(dcr05_title, dcr05_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{titleName}) ORDER BY COALESCE(LPAD(sys09_seq,3,'0'),'000'), sys09_code, dcr05_title
